statement: For every admissible coprime integer weight pair (u,d) with |u|,|d|<=2 and (u,d)!=(0,0), and for each tie order t in {L,R}, the additive-level sort Phi_{u,d}^t restricted to the Dyck language is realizable by a partial polyregular map if and only if u*d>=0. The supplied evidence gives an explicit one-copy MSO/regular presentation for every positive labeled case and a regular-slice pumping obstruction for every negative labeled case, covering all 32 triples under the precise interpretation in problem.md.
contribution: A complete resolution of the frozen bounded classification. It combines the previously proved 20 nonnegative/nonpositive cases with self-contained lower bounds for all six mixed-sign representatives (both tie orders), including reconstruction of the source's (1,-1,R) obstruction, a new left-tie parity probe, and four asymmetric-weight suffix probes; simultaneous negation then covers the other six mixed-sign triples. This requests fresh mathematical audit and makes no certified priority claim.
